analysis.reason: RSI는 과매도 구간을 탈출했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물러 있다. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이지만 추세 전환을 확신하기에는 이르다. ADX 15.4로 추세가 형성되지 않아 변동성에 대한 신뢰도가 낮다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 0.65로 거래량 위축 상태다. 따라서 현 구간은 관망하며 추가 지표 확인이 필요하다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement, but it's too early to confirm a trend reversal. ADX at 15.4 indicates a lack of trend, lowering confidence in volatility. Volume ratio is 0.65, showing contraction. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted pending further indicator confirmation.

[모멘텀 지표]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 추가 지표 확인 후 진입 결정 필요

[Trend Position]
· Current price ($81.80) vs SMA5 ($81.28)/SMA20 ($81.85)/SMA50 ($82.23): below short-term, below mid-term, below long-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($83.28)/SMA200 ($84.34): below long-term, weak downtrend continuation.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.7→49.8) + exiting oversold, entering neutral zone + weakening upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1201→0.0225) + improvement diagnosis + trend reversal signal unconfirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $81.85) + normal band width interpretation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($81.17) + basis (pivot-based).
· Swing resistance ($83.60) + potential upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) + lack of trend direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.65x) + decreased reliability of movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (accumulation) + entry decision needed after further indicator confirmation.
